key_provisions_or_claims: Stability, visibility and functional tests for self-propelled industrial trucks must follow the Annex methods.
Member States must transpose by the same date as Directive 86/663/EEC.
Annex sets 13 test methods, e.g. tilting-platform stability tests for counterbalanced, reach, order-picking and rough terrain trucks.
Functional tests include lowering speed (max 0.6 m/s) and lift/tilt leakage checks.
Visibility measured by a lamp-shadow method for counterbalanced fork lifts.
annotation.summary_en: Commission Directive 89/240/EEC adapts Directive 86/663/EEC on self-propelled industrial trucks to technical progress by adopting test methods for stability, visibility and function. The Annex sets out 13 detailed methods for forklift-type trucks. It covers conventional manually operated trucks, not AI or autonomous systems.
